title: Step-position measurement report
purpose: Exercise the server-to-client monitoring path with a measurement TypeID, object address, step-position value, and quality descriptor in a distinct I-format shape.
expected_behavior: The peer parses an I-format monitoring ASDU as M_ST_NA_1 with one information object, spontaneous cause, common address 1, information object address 1, step position 5, and a zero quality descriptor.
constraints_preserved: IEC 60870-5-104 I-format framing with four APCI control bytes
Length 0x0f matches four control bytes plus an eleven-byte ASDU
The monitoring direction is server to client
The step-position value and quality descriptor follow the three-byte information object address
issue_safety_notes: PK-only monitoring seed with ordinary bounded measurement and quality values; no issue-specific payload or vulnerability claim is included.
